system.description:
Battle Amp

While in this state, you gain the following benefits;

Expanded Limit. You can have up to 8 Primes active at once.

If Looks Could Kill. Once per turn, you can detonate a single Primed creature without spending an action on your turn.

Lethal Charge. You can infuse up to 3 different Payloads into a detonation.

Terrain Buster. All detonations can create difficult terrain in the affected area.
system.summary: Up to 8 Primes, one free detonation a turn, 3 Payloads per detonation, and detonations can leave difficult terrain.
